responsibility: Implements thunk metadata storage, streaming, and expansion into real code or target-specific output. It manages thunk_info summaries, early thunk registration for PCH safety, serialization to LTO streams, hashing/dumping, pointer-adjustment helpers, and the logic that builds a thunk body in GIMPLE when a backend hook does not emit an assembly thunk directly. This is the main thunk execution/support file for symtab and cgraph users.
same_name_distinction: Implements thunk support declared in symtab-thunks.h: thunk summary allocation/duplication, LTO streaming, dumping/hashing, early registration, pointer adjustment helpers, and expand_thunk body generation or emission support.
